create.name: Chitra Sukhu
create.bio:
Chitra Sukhu is a yoga and Vedanta teacher who grew up inside the Sivananda tradition. Born in Guyana and raised mainly in the United States, she is the daughter of Yogi Hari and Leela Mata, who both ran ashrams, and she has kept a daily practice of yoga and meditation since early childhood. She trained in Ayurveda with Kerala Ayurveda and holds Yoga Alliance's senior E-RYT 500 registration, but she says she claims no single guru and counts life itself as her main teacher.

Her best-known work is Yoga Nidra | Awak{end} Sleep, a method of guided yogic sleep that she presents as a full path towards awakening; she has trained hundreds of people to teach it, at ashrams and studios in North America and Europe and live online. She also teaches Tantra meditation drawn from the Vijnana Bhairava Tantra, runs a year-long online course on reaching the inner guru, offers one-to-one spiritual consultations, and leads group journeys to India. Through New Age Kids she has made meditation and affirmation recordings for children, and she created a yoga teacher training for young people aged sixteen to twenty-one. She lives in Atlanta when not travelling.

courses.title: Online LIVE Yoga Nidra | Awak{end} Sleep Teachers Training Level 2
courses.description: A live online training of about twenty hours over four days for teachers who have finished her Level 1 course. It goes further into the states of consciousness behind yoga nidra, script writing for different groups, the chakras, and the classical texts.

courses.title: Tantra: Techniques for Transformation and Liberation
courses.description: A sixteen-week online course teaching five meditation methods chosen from the Vijnana Bhairava Tantra, with a few extra techniques as a bonus. The aim is to live with more presence rather than on autopilot.

courses.title: From Here to Enlightenment - Gain Access to your Inner Guru
courses.description: A year-long online course in which she releases a new practice or tool every other week, twenty-six in all, with access to her for questions. It is built around reaching what she calls the inner guru, or buddhi.

courses.title: Spiritual Consultation
courses.description: One-to-one sessions, in person or on Zoom, for questions about the spiritual path, yoga, Vedanta, meditation or daily life. For practical questions she may also use divination cards.

free_resources.title: Chakra Guided Meditation - Swadhisthana
free_resources.description: A free guided meditation of about eight minutes on her YouTube channel, focused on the second chakra.
